description: Awarding the contract for the completion of balance work of the New Hostel Block for the National Police Academy at Katana
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-17 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Department of Buildings, which is the procurement entity of the Project for the completion of balance work of the New Hostel Block for the National Police Academy at Katana, has invited bids under the National Competitive Bidding procedure to select a suitable contractor for the remaining works of the said building. Ten (10) bidders have submitted bids for the same. Based on the recommendations made by the High Level Procurement Committee, the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to award the contract for the remaining works of the new hostel building for the National Police Academy, to M/s Central Engineering Services (Pvt) Ltd., the substantially responsive lowest bidder, for a sum of Rs.614.98 million (VAT excluded), was approved by the Cabinet.
